The surface is now taken verbatim from Chromium IDL, and constructor behaviour was browser-verified in Chrome 153 with --enable-blink-features=GamepadRawInputChangeEvent. Identity, route and slug unchanged; the 149 origin trial is disclosed without moving the page.
